# RD3N

> Independent engineering studio by Nizam Yüksel. Product and venture development, industrial machine design, applied AI and GitHub-based company memory systems.

RD3N (rd3n.com) is the studio of Nizam Yüksel: machine and test-system design, parametric CAD and production documentation, plus applied AI work — most actively a GitHub-based company memory system (RD3N Kit) that organises company knowledge, project history and decision records with human-reviewed AI workflows. Currently offered as a manual setup with consulting (pilot stage).

## Main sections

- [Work](https://rd3n.com/#work): visual studies and concept work, each image labelled as an AI-generated concept.
- [Fields](https://rd3n.com/#fields): three connected fields — product & venture development, industrial design, applied AI & company memory.
- [About](https://rd3n.com/#about): how Nizam works — learn, experiment, deliver something useful.
- [Contact](https://rd3n.com/#contact): partner@rd3n.com, LinkedIn and GitHub (github.com/rd3n-ai).

## Honest limits

- Visuals on this site are AI-generated concept images, not delivered client work or manufactured machines.
- No client case studies are published yet; project evidence will be added as real projects complete.
- The RD3N Kit company-memory system is in pilot stage: manual setup and consulting only, not a self-service product.
